items.question: Did the assessment describe the growth as benign?
items.note: "That is a benign growth, Niels. Benign meaning harmless." Also #06 (46.24-51.84) and #17 (129.10-136.88).

items.question: The doctor concluded seborrheic keratosis, right?
items.note: "It is a seborrheic keratosis." Also "The conclusion is that it is a seborrheic keratosis, and that it is benign." (#06, 46.24-51.84).

items.question: Is the patient asking for the result of the removed skin change?
items.note: "Is there an answer on that skin change you took off under my breast?"

items.question: Did the consultation take place on the Millennium Falcon?
Does the patient still await removal of the lesion?
items.note: Opposite: it was taken off before; this is the result.

items.question: Had the lesion already been removed before this contact?
items.note: "that skin change you took off under my breast" and "when someone cuts something off you and sends it away" (#08, 56.66-65.64). model: no. The twin negative is q5.

items.question: Did they talk about the patient's daily commute?
Should the patient be reassured that the change is harmless?
Were the results communicated through an e-consultation?
items.note: "What I have done is send you the information about the benign result as a written reply in the electronic consultation system."

items.question: Is the growth described as malignant?
items.note: Opposite: "Benign means not malignant, not cancerous." (#17).
